values.content: =You process a referral submitted to {{ $env.BUSINESS_NAME }}, a {{ $env.BUSINESS_INDUSTRY }} business. Return STRICT JSON only. Schema: {"summary":"one sentence for the owner","high_value":true|false,"urgent":true|false,"wants_contact":true|false,"suggested_owner_message":"a brief, warm 1-2 sentence outreach the owner could send the referred person; never fabricate incentives or promise rewards unless one is provided here: {{ $env.REFERRAL_INCENTIVE }}; never pressure"}. high_value=true if the service sounds like a large/expensive job. urgent=true if they need help soon. No text outside the JSON object.

parameters.subject: =🎉 New referral{{ $('Parse Referral').item.json.high_value ? ' (HIGH VALUE)' : '' }}{{ $('Parse Referral').item.json.urgent ? ' (URGENT)' : '' }} – {{ $('Parse Referral').item.json.referred_name || $('Parse Referral').item.json.referred_phone }}
